info.title: Agent Web Map API
info.description: Agent Web Map is the directory of websites publishing llms.txt: found across the web, validated continuously and ranked by authority, with a free JSON API and MCP server so AI agents can look any site up. Public discovery has no automatic daily or pagination quotas. Usage is monitored; only explicit operator source blocks deny discovery access. Optional integration identity uses Authorization: Bearer awm_client_… or X-AgentWebMap-Key, separate from owner keys. Responses are private, no-store. See https://agentwebmap.com/docs#limits. Compact fields are the default; detail=full includes owner metadata. Ownership verification proves identity, not documentation correctness. MCP server: https://agentwebmap.com/mcp

get.summary: Publisher heading catalogue, distinct-site counts, emerging labels and coverage
get.description: Labels come from the indexed corpus. Newest shows labels observed after the baseline. Emerging additionally requires positive seven-day growth, ten estimated domain-name families from complete files without known templates/duplicates, and three days of observation. These are index signals, not adoption dates. Seven-day changes count net site memberships after the baseline; headings do not certify capabilities.
